name: A Wildcard Hero trains the ranks of what it knows at any class trainer and Book of Ascension
contract: A Wildcard Hero rolls its abilities at rank 1 and has no trainer of its own. Any class trainer, of whatever class, and any Book of Ascension teach it the higher ranks of the spells it knows, at the price and level of the class trainer that lists them: Arcane Shot rank 2 (14281, level 12) at a rogue trainer and Arcane Missiles rank 2 (5144, level 16) at a Book of Ascension. A rank whose lower rank it does not know is refused. The Wildcard Auto shot entry's passive (965202) brings Auto Shot (75) with it and takes it away again.

A rank without its lower rank is refused

Ask the book for Arcane Missiles rank 2 below its level
